Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal
The board's native implementations: the classes whose methods are compiler intrinsics.
  • Classes in io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal used by io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal
    Class
    Description
    NativeAudio
    The M5Stack Cardputer's Audio, implemented by a compiler intrinsic over M5Cardputer.Speaker.
    NativeBattery
    The M5Stack Cardputer's battery, implemented by compiler intrinsics over M5Cardputer.Power.
    NativeBoardMemory
    The board's BoardMemory: each method is an intrinsic the compiler lowers to its runtime shim, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeBoardModel
    The board's BoardModel: each method is an intrinsic the compiler folds to a constant for the target board, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeClock
    The board's Clock: each method is a clock intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino core call, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeDisplay
    The M5Stack Cardputer's Display, implemented by compiler intrinsics over M5StackCardputer.Display.
    NativeGpio
    The board's Gpio: each method is a GPIO intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino core call, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeI2c
    The board's I2c: each method is an I2C intrinsic the compiler lowers to the core-bundled Wire library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeKeyboard
    The M5Stack Cardputer's Keyboard, implemented by compiler intrinsics over M5StackCardputer.Keyboard.
    NativeLedMatrix
    The board's LedMatrix: each method is an LED matrix intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino_LED_Matrix library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeMouse
    The board's Mouse: each method is a USB HID intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino Mouse library (the core's USBHIDMouse on ESP32-S3 boards), so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeSpi
    The board's Spi bus: each method is an SPI intrinsic the compiler lowers to the core-bundled SPI library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
    NativeWifi
    The board's Wifi: each method is a Wi-Fi intrinsic the compiler lowers to the board's networking library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
